title: How about going to Ireland for nine days in 2022?

body:
Grace and I loved our first trip to Ireland with Gareth Higgins so much that we’re joining him again in 2022.

 The pace of travel is perfect. The combination of rest, renewal, and learning is ideal. The settings, of course, are magical. Your fellow travelers will be fascinating. And the chance to learn from Gareth and his friends in Ireland about the challenging work of peacemaking will inspire us for our work back home.

 I hope you’ll consider joining us! This year, Gareth and I will speak about a theme we’ve collaborated on for several years: A Better Story for a Better World. We’ll engage with the material we’ve written about in our 7th Story writings, which you can learn more about here: https://www.theseventhstory.com/

 You’ll find details about how you can be part of the 2022 Ireland retreat here: https://www.irelandretreats.com/2022-retreats

 Space is limited, and these retreats tend to fill up fast, so it’s a good idea to plan ahead now. (This might be a great Christmas present for you and someone you love!)
